name: @pipeworx/mcp-japan-tariff

tools.name: jp_tariff_lookup
tools.description: Look up Japan's applied customs tariff rates by HS code: the line description and the general, temporary, WTO, GSP and LDC duty rates, the rate under each economic partnership agreement (CPTPP, EU, UK, RCEP, ASEAN, Australia, India, Switzerland and others, plus the JP-US trade agreement) and the quantity units. Accepts a 2-digit chapter, 4-digit heading (e.g. 0713 dried legumes), 6-digit subheading or 9-digit statistical code, with or without dots; a longer foreign code is cut to its first 6 digits. Answers 'what duty does Japan charge on this HS code', 'Japan import tariff on X', 'Japan EPA preferential rate for Y'. Returns the schedule edition date; an unknown code returns found:false.

hs_code.description: HS code, 2 to 9 digits, dots optional (e.g. "0713", "0713.32", "071332010"). Codes longer than 9 digits are cut to 6.

partner.description: Optional trade-agreement partner to keep in epa_rates, e.g. "cptpp", "eu", "uk", "india", "rcep", "viet_nam", "australia".

tools.name: jp_tariff_search
tools.description: Search Japan's customs tariff schedule by product keyword (English) and get the matching HS lines with their headline duty rates (general, WTO, GSP, LDC). Use it to find which HS code and duty rate Japan applies to a product such as beans, green tea, lithium batteries, wine or cotton fabric, then call jp_tariff_lookup for every partnership rate. Optional chapter (1-97) limits the search to one HS chapter. Returns the schedule edition date; no match returns found:false with a hint.

keyword.description: Product words in English, e.g. "adzuki beans", "green tea", "lithium battery". All words must appear.

chapter.description: Optional HS chapter 1-97 to search within (rates then come from that chapter live).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-japan-tariff forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the japan-tariff pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
